Columns are in `COLUMNS.md`; function = `code/37_pipeline_table.py` (pipelines) and `24_aggregate_ct.py` (extras). What each result is: RMSE on the model's observed T cells (raw points), mean over its eligible splits (20 of the 50 shared splits for these files), equal weight per model, 154 fixed-k_max G models; `diff_vs_P5` = RMSE(sel+P5) - RMSE(sel+Px) paired by model, positive = Px better. P2 = ridge on the revealed benchmarks trained on the EM-completed training matrix; P3 kNN over training models; P4 Soft-Impute row update; P6 PC regression with sigmoid link (adaptation, not as published); P2-P4 hyperparameters tuned by inner CV per k. Headline readings (G): P5 is best or tied for k <= 12 with S6; at k = 32 S6+P2 is lower than S6+P5 by 0.29 [0.20, 0.39] (inside delta_floor). S7 is worse than random-k from k = 12; S3 from k = 20. So "better inference" holds at small k only; the Outline asks for it as a hypothesis tied to Table 3, and the result is mixed. Still owed: S7-vs-batch on synthetic data, Open LLM LB (running).
